# Reelwright

> Reelwright is a local-first, open-source (MIT) MCP server that turns a website into Instagram Reels. Claude (or any MCP client) writes the copy; Reelwright renders a 1080x1920 reel on the user's own machine with Remotion, waits for explicit human approval, and publishes through the official Instagram API using a temporary Cloudflare tunnel or the user's own S3/R2 bucket. Optional local voice-over through any OpenAI-compatible TTS (e.g. VoiceStudio). No cloud service, no subscription.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): quick start, tools, security model, status
- [Instagram setup](docs/instagram.md): Meta developer app, token, permissions
- [Storage](docs/storage.md): tunnel vs S3/R2
- [Voice-over](docs/voice.md): local TTS
- [Connecting clients](docs/claude.md): Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor
- [Security policy](SECURITY.md)

## Install

npm install -g reelwright && reelwright setup

## MCP tools

doctor, brand_init, brand_get, render_reel, list_reels, get_reel, publish_reel, get_comments, reply_comment
